verdict.rationale: Docs confirm a command-line/automation toolchain (Unreal Automation Tool 'used to automate processes, including testing and building games', plus command-line arguments for running the editor in game mode) that could support headless CI test runs against the real engine, but there is no documentation of a unit/integration test framework, no CI recipe, and no confirmation that the Automation System actually runs assertions headlessly in a pipeline. Missing for 10: explicit unit/integration testing framework docs, headless CI examples, and independent confirmation that automated tests run against the real engine in CI.
